title: Label-free, machine-learning assisted impedance assessment of basophil activation.
summary: The primary Methods and Results show label-free IFC signals from 15 donors were mapped to FCA reference activation using leave-one-donor-out cross-validation; this is a specific ex-vivo basophil activation assay result, not clinical deployment.
